title: Gather / GatherV2 / BurnerV2 lack generic token rescue
description: None of these dispatchers expose an owner-only `rescueERC20`. In normal operation tokens pass through immediately, so this is low risk. However, tokens sent directly to the contract (user error, integration mishap, or via H-01 attacker's fake token transfers) become permanently stuck. Notably V1 Gather has no recovery either, though it is a pass-through so accumulation is not expected.
impact: Permanently-stuck tokens from accidental transfers; no operational path to recover user or protocol funds.
attack_path: User or integration mistakenly transfers tokens directly to dispatcher contract.
recommendation: Add `rescueERC20(address token, address to, uint256 amount) onlyOwner` to the ATokenDispatcher/V2 base.
